subject: Surgical video - annotation accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed [COMPANY] is expanding surgical data annotation efforts - a
critical function to connect surgical insights with robotic operations.
We've been working with Moon Surgical, Kaliber Labs, and Telos Health at
similar intersections, helping them improve annotation consistency across
surgical video, robotic ops and medical imaging (DICOM/NIfTI).

With Encord, surgical teams consolidate these tasks in one platform. Our
capabilities like temporal interpolation & tracking, nested attributes, and
workflow orchestration have helped them reduce manual labelling time,
capture granular surgical contexts and flag deviations more reliably.

Would you be open to a quick chat to see if those challenges resonate with
what you're seeing at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times PT.

subject: Annotation throughput for VLM
text:
Hi [NAME],

My colleague was in touch with Chris Hall and it sounded like increasing
labelling throughput + more comprehensive modality support for VLM (syncing
video, audio & text) were potential areas of improvement for Vivint. So I
wanted to introduce myself as your point of contact at Encord - a curation,
annotation & dataset evaluation platform for video-centric ML teams.

We've onboarded safety / surveillance companies like Flock Safety,
Milestone Systems & LVT from first-gen/ open source tools like CVAT,
Voxel51 or Vertex AI. By moving to our integrated platform they were able
to 6x annotation throughput.

For teams with in-house labelling workforce, our auto-annotation and
organizational analytics help focus manual efforts on label/ caption
correction, resulting in more consistent datasets with up to 30%
improvement in annotation accuracy.

Would you be open to see if there are avenues to similar outcomes at
Vivint? We're flexible morning times MT for a quick chat.
